faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Get clear answers regarding fertilizer availability, digital billing, bulk delivery, and product genuineness.
faq.q1: Are all fertilizers and pesticides sold here genuine and licensed?
faq.a1: Yes, absolutely. Ahammed Fertilizer operates under official West Bengal Agriculture Department licenses. All chemical bags come with company batch seals and QR codes for authenticity.
faq.q2: Do you provide POS / Aadhaar-linked subsidized fertilizer billing?
faq.a2: Yes, we are equipped with the Government mFMS POS terminal for direct Aadhaar-linked subsidized sales of Urea, DAP, MOP, and complex fertilizers.
faq.q3: Can I get customized dosage advice for my specific crop?
faq.a3: Definitely. Visit our counter or connect with us on WhatsApp with pictures of your standing crop or leaf symptoms. We will advise you on the exact dosage per bigha/acre.
faq.q4: Do you arrange bulk tractor-load deliveries for farmer groups?
faq.a4: Yes, we facilitate bulk deliveries for farmer groups, cooperative societies, and large acreage growers throughout the Dakshin Dinajpur region.
faq.q5: What payment methods are accepted at the shop?
faq.a5: We accept Cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking, and Kisan Credit Card (KCC) partner bank transfers.
faq.q6: Do you stock organic fertilizers and bio-pesticides?
faq.a6: Yes, we maintain a robust inventory of city compost, neem cake, vermicompost, Trichoderma, Pseudomonas, and certified bio-stimulants.
faq.q7: How can I check if a particular brand or product is in stock?
faq.a7: You can check our real-time product catalog right on this website, or click the WhatsApp button to enquire instantly with our inventory counter.
faq.q8: What are your peak season working hours?
faq.a8: During peak sowing seasons (Boro sowing, Potato plantation, Aman transplantation), we open early from 6:30 AM to 9:00 PM every day including Sundays.

about.storyTitle: Our Journey: Dedicated to the Soil of Dakshin Dinajpur
about.storyP1: Ahammed Fertilizer was established in 2015 with a straightforward mission: to eradicate spurious, adulterated farm inputs from the local market and provide regional cultivators with genuine, high-potency agro-inputs at honest prices.
about.storyP2: Over the years, we have transitioned from a modest neighborhood retail counter into one of Dakshin Dinajpur's most dependable agricultural supply hubs. We have forged direct distributorship ties with India's most respected agrochemical and seed corporations.
about.storyP3: Beyond commerce, we function as a trusted advisory destination. Every day, dozens of cultivators walk into our store seeking practical advice on soil conditioning, pest outbreaks, and fertilizer optimization to protect their investments and ensure prosperity.
